quests.title: Tatara Tales: Purification Device

dialogue.t: Hopefully this is as far as the situation escalates...
It'll take a while longer...

dialogue.sit: Have you gathered all the necessary data?

dialogue.t: Ah, it's you! Wonderful. We haven't quite collected all the data we need yet. I believe it will take a little more time.
That said, I've taken this opportunity to think about the structure of the emergency purifier...
Just a last-minute trick I've pulled.
According to our previous discussions, we must deal with a two-pronged problem: the Fatui and the Tatarigami within.
I trust you will be able to deal with the Fatui. My part in this, therefore, is to deal with the Tatarigami energy.
This emergency purifier is a device that I have had purpose-built for that task. However, I'm going to need your help to complete it.

dialogue.sit: And here I thought you'd have a more official name...

dialogue.t: We will need some special materials to ensure this device functions smoothly within the Mikage Furnace.
Crystal Marrow, which contains an inert form of Tatarigami energy, is an ideal candidate for this task.
In truth, the secret of the famed Jade Steel is that a special method is used to add this very material during the forging process to increase the strength of the metal.
Of course, the special method in question is a trade secret.
If memory serves, this crystalline ore can be found nearby. Please help me obtain three chunks.
Well then, you have my thanks. Remember, it's 3 chunks of Crystal Marrow — bring them back once you've got them.
Have you got your hands on 3 Crystal Marrow chunks yet?
Do you have those 3 Crystal Marrow chunks for me?
Thank you, truly! These shall form the basic structure of our device.
Now, all we need to do is wait for our beacons to collect enough data.
Once we have that data on hand, I will make a few tweaks to this device accordingly.
Once all is ready, let us put a decisive end to this incident.

quests.description: Xavier, who is researching the Mikage Furnace, seems to have had some new idea…
